# Reading in data

Created in ifph-inform-join

```{r}
ifph_inform <- read_csv("data/ifph_inform_full.csv")
fire_mp <- st_read("data/ifph_inform_multipolygon.shp")
fire_pt <- st_read("data/ifph_inform_point.shp")

```

# Fire Severity Feature

## exploration

```{r}
ifph_inform %>% 
    group_by(is_inform, is_ifph) %>%
    summarize(n=n())

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity, Incident.Type.Category) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres)

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(is_inform) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres)

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Incident.Type.Category) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n()
    ) %>%
    arrange(n)
```

```{r}
ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity, Incident.Type.Category) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        max_acres = max(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        min_acres = min(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres) %>%
    print(width=Inf)

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(is_inform) %>%
    summarize(
        n=n(),
        avg_acres = mean(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        max_acres = max(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        median_acres = median(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE),
        min_acres = min(GIS_ACRES, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(avg_acres) %>%
    print(width=Inf)
```

# FEATURES

- Acres burned
- Burn duration
- Fire management complexity

## Acres burned

Already exists with no missingness - GIS_ACR

```{r}
dim(fire_mp %>%
    filter(is.na(GIS_ACR)))
```

## Fire management complexity

Already exists - Fr_Mg_C

```{r}
# THERE SHOULD BE MORE THAN THAT. 
fire_mp %>%
    select(Fr_Mg_C) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Fr_Mg_C))

ifph_inform %>%
    group_by(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity) %>%
    summarize(n=n())

fire_df %>%
    group_by(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity) %>%
    summarize(n=n())

# significant missingness - 1531 missing total
# 665 missing where inform data is present
# can be converted to numeric category for modeling, all 1-5 no extra text
fire_df <- fire_df %>%
    mutate(fire_mgmt_n = as.numeric(str_extract(Fire.Mgmt.Complexity, "[1-5]"))) 

fire_shp <- fire_shp %>%
    mutate(fire_mgmt_n = as.numeric(str_extract(Fr_Mg_C, "[1-5]")))

```

## Burn Duration

```{r}
fire_df %>%
    group_by(is.na(Containment.Date.Time), is.na(Control.Date.Time), is.na(FireOutDateTime)) %>%
    summarize(n=n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    print(width=Inf)
# 17 missing all three

fire_df <- fire_df %>%
    filter(!(is.na(Containment.Date.Time) & is.na(Control.Date.Time) & is.na(FireOutDateTime)))

# Cntn_D_T, Cntr_D_T, FrOtDtT
fire_shp <- fire_shp %>%
    filter(!(is.na(Cntn_D_T) & is.na(Cntr_D_T) & is.na(FrOtDtT)))

```

```{r}
# creating latest_out column
fire_df %>%
    rowwise %>%
    mutate(
        latest_out = max(c(Containment.Date.Time, Control.Date.Time, FireOutDateTime), na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    select(Containment.Date.Time, Control.Date.Time, FireOutDateTime, latest_out) %>%
    print(width=Inf)

fire_df <- fire_df %>%
    rowwise %>%
    mutate(
        latest_out = max(c(Containment.Date.Time, Control.Date.Time, FireOutDateTime), na.rm=TRUE)
    )

fire_shp %>%
    rowwise %>%
    mutate(
        latest_out = max(c(Cntn_D_T, Cntr_D_T, FrOtDtT), na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    select(Cntn_D_T, Cntr_D_T, FrOtDtT, latest_out) %>%
    print(width=Inf)

fire_shp <- fire_shp %>%
    rowwise %>%
    mutate(
        latest_out = max(c(Cntn_D_T, Cntr_D_T, FrOtDtT), na.rm=TRUE)
    )

```

```{r}
# calculated the duration between fire discovery and latest out
fire_df %>%
    mutate(fire_duration = as.duration(interval(Fire.Discovery.Date.Time, latest_out))) %>%
    mutate(duration_hrs = as.numeric(fire_duration, "hours")) %>%
    select(Fire.Discovery.Date.Time, latest_out, fire_duration, duration_hrs) %>%
    print(width=Inf)

fire_df <- fire_df %>%
    mutate(fire_duration = as.duration(interval(Fire.Discovery.Date.Time, latest_out))) %>%
    mutate(duration_hrs = as.numeric(fire_duration, "hours"))

fire_shp <- cbind(fire_shp, fire_df$duration_hrs)

```

```{r}
st_write(fire_shp, "data/fire_shp.shp")
write_csv(fire_df, "data/fire_df.csv")
```
